planning_notes: Board is authoritative: arduino:avr:uno; wiring uses D2/D3 buttons, TM1637 CLK=D4 and DIO=D5, LED=D13, buzzer=D6 exactly as given.

Active-high/active-low electrical polarity and pullup/pulldown for buttons are not specified in the requirements; inputs default to MODEL false at startup and the SysML model decides pressed/unpressed mapping without additional inversion here.
LED behavior (even->on, odd->off) and buzzer alarm + latch/reset logic are implemented in the SysML model; this proposal only registers the required physical I/O.
Control step updates all outputs each control period; button edge detection, long-press detection, alarm latch, and count wrap/reset rules belong in the SysML model (not in device requests).
No serial communication was requested; therefore serial_channels is empty.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Count up button (long-press not used here; reset uses D3 long-press)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Count down button (long-press resets latched alarm/count)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: LED state: ON when count is even; OFF when count is odd

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer alarm tone when count reaches 15; silenced when not alarming

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 设计一个交互式计数与报警系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 加一，D3 减一，数码管显示当前值；当计数为偶数时 LED 亮，为奇数时 LED 灭；当计数达到 15 时蜂鸣器报警并锁定计数，直到长按 D3 复位。
